title: Anti-exfil PSBT fields: test vectors from the BIP39 test mnemonic
note: Companion of bip-anti-exfil-psbt.json for a device that holds a seed and cannot load raw keys. Same schema as its `exchanges`, with the derivations of each input's keys in place of the label seed. The wallet is the mnemonic that BIP84 and BIP86 publish test vectors for, so a device that stores a mnemonic can hold it; the keys have no value and must never hold funds. Previous transactions are synthetic. The ids are not those of the other file.

seed.source: BIP39 mnemonic of the BIP84 and BIP86 test vectors; seed by BIP39 (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 2048 rounds, salt "mnemonic")
seed.mnemonic: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon about

paths.roles: key a is at index 0, b at 1, c at 2, a Taproot internal key at 3; the device holds a, plus b in the 2-of-3 forms; in p2tr-key-root key b is the one key of the single leaf (the device does not sign it)

bip32_check.check: Before the file is written, the derivation code in scripts/gen_psbt_vectors.py serializes the extended private keys of the chains m, m/0H, m/0H/1 and m/0H/1/2H of BIP32 test vector 1 and compares them byte for byte, checksum included, with the published values. This checks the master key, hardened and normal private derivation, chain codes and the parent fingerprint. It then derives the seed of the mnemonic above and compares the root key with the one BIP86 publishes, and the keys at m/86'/0'/0'/0/0 (Taproot internal key, before tweaking) and m/84'/0'/0'/0/0 with those BIP86 and BIP84 publish. Addresses are not compared. The generator stops on a mismatch.

encoding: All byte strings are lowercase hex. PSBTs are serialized with keys sorted within each map; a reader must not depend on order.
